changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE registration.cost_centers ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp NOT NULL, active boolean NOT NULL, name varchar(150) NOT NULL, expense_budget numeric(15, 2), income_budget numeric(15, 2), description text, id_parent bigint, full_name varchar(300), CONSTRAINT cost_centers_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT cost_centers_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT cost_centers_id_external_id_key UNIQUE (id, external_id), CONSTRAINT fk_parent_on_cost_centers FOREIGN KEY (id_parent) REFERENCES registration.cost_centers (id) );

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE registration.wallets ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, name varchar(150) NOT NULL, type varchar(24) NOT NULL, current_balance numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, active boolean NOT NULL, description text, bank varchar(150), agency varchar(16), number varchar(10), CONSTRAINT wallets_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT wallets_id_external_id_key UNIQUE (id, external_id), CONSTRAINT wallets_bank_agency_number_key UNIQUE (bank, agency, number) );

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE registration.cards ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, active boolean NOT NULL, name varchar(150) NOT NULL, last_four_digits varchar(4) NOT NULL, type varchar(45) NOT NULL, invoice_payment_day integer, flag varchar(50), id_wallet bigint, CONSTRAINT cards_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT cards_id_external_id_key UNIQUE (id, external_id), CONSTRAINT cards_last_four_digits_type_key UNIQUE (last_four_digits, type), CONSTRAINT fk_wallets_on_cards FOREIGN KEY (id_wallet) REFERENCES registration.wallets (id) );

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE registration.financial_periods ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, name varchar(150) NOT NULL, starting_at date NOT NULL, ending_at date NOT NULL, status varchar(20) NOT NULL, expenses_goal numeric(15, 2), revenues_goal numeric(15, 2), CONSTRAINT financial_periods_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT financial_periods_id_external_id_key UNIQUE (id, external_id), CONSTRAINT financial_periods_name_key UNIQUE (name) );
